22345-memoirs-of-the-private-life-return.title: Memoirs Of The Private Life Return And Reign Of Napoleon In
22345-memoirs-of-the-private-life-return.creator: Unknown
22345-memoirs-of-the-private-life-return.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. facts it reveals, appears to me to merit the reader's attention in other respects. On studying it carefully, we find in it the exhibition of those defects, those qualities, those passions, which, confounded together, form the character, so full of contrasts, of the incomprehensible Napoleon. We perceive him alternatively mistrustful and communicative, ardent and reserved, enterprising and irresolute, vindictive and generous, favourable to liberty and despotic.

47616-the-children-s-book-of-gardening.title: The Children S Book Of Gardening
47616-the-children-s-book-of-gardening.creator: MISS CONWAY and SIR MARTIN CONWAY
47616-the-children-s-book-of-gardening.description: A book by MISS CONWAY and SIR MARTIN CONWAY. THE first thing to decide is that you really want a garden of your own, and mean to work in it and keep it clean and tidy. The next thing is to learn a little about situation and soil, because you cannot choose which plants to grow until you know what conditions you can give them.

arxiv-2004-07944.title: Cityscapes-Panoptic-Parts and PASCAL-Panoptic-Parts datasets for Scene Understanding
arxiv-2004-07944.creator: Panagiotis Meletis, Xiaoxiao Wen
arxiv-2004-07944.description: Abstract In this technical report, we present two novel datasets for image scene understanding. Both datasets have annotations compatible with panoptic segmentation and additionally they have part-level labels for selected semantic classes. This report describes the format of the two datasets, the annotation protocols, the merging strategies, and presents the datasets statistics.

arxiv-2011-11949.title: Di-Higgs production as a probe of flavor changing neutral Yukawa couplings
arxiv-2011-11949.creator: Shi-Ping He
arxiv-2011-11949.description: Abstract Top partners are well motivated in many new physics models. Usually, vector like quarks T L , R T_{L,R} are introduced to avoid the quantum anomaly. It is crucial to probe their interactions with the standard model particles. However, flavor changing neutral couplings are always difficult to detect directly in the current and future experiments.

arxiv-2104-11832.title: Playing Lottery Tickets with Vision and Language
arxiv-2104-11832.creator: Zhe Gan, Yen-Chun Chen, Linjie Li, Tianlong Chen, Yu Cheng, Shuohang Wang, Jingjing Liu, Lijuan Wang, Zicheng Liu
arxiv-2104-11832.description: Abstract Large-scale pre-training has recently revolutionized vision-and-language (VL) research. Models such as LXMERT and UNITER have significantly lifted the state of the art over a wide range of VL tasks. However, the large number of parameters in such models hinders their application in practice.

arxiv-2112-10272.title: A Multi-Layout Design for Immersive Visualization of Network Data
arxiv-2112-10272.creator: David Bauer, Chengbo Zheng, Oh-Hyun Kwon, Kwan-Liu Ma
arxiv-2112-10272.description: Abstract . Visualization plays a vital role in making sense of complex network data. Recent studies have shown the potential of using extended reality (XR) for the immersive exploration of networks. The additional depth cues offered by XR help users perform better in certain tasks when compared to using traditional desktop setups.

arxiv-2112-11020.title: Efficient reductions and algorithms for variants of Subset Sum Thanks: A preliminary version of this work has been accepted to CALDAM 2022.
arxiv-2112-11020.creator: Pranjal Dutta, Mahesh Sreekumar Rajasree
arxiv-2112-11020.description: Abstract Given ( a 1 , … , a n , t ) ∈ ℤ ≥ 0 n + 1 (a_{1},\dots,a_{n},t)\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}^{n+1} , the Subset Sum problem ( 𝖲𝖲𝖴𝖬 \mathsf{SSUM} ) is to decide whether there exists S ⊆ [ n ] S\subseteq[n] such that ∑ i ∈ S a i = t \sum_{i\in S}a_{i}=t .

arxiv-2206-07801.title: Beyond Adult and COMPAS: Fairness in Multi-Class Prediction
arxiv-2206-07801.creator: Wael Alghamdi, Hsiang Hsu, Haewon Jeong, Hao Wang, P. Winston Michalak, Shahab Asoodeh, and Flavio P. Calmon
arxiv-2206-07801.description: Abstract We consider the problem of producing fair probabilistic classifiers for multi-class classification tasks. We formulate this problem in terms of “projecting” a pre-trained (and potentially unfair) classifier onto the set of models that satisfy target group-fairness requirements. The new, projected model is given by post-processing the outputs of the pre-trained classifier by a multiplicative factor.

arxiv-2211-03676.title: Scaling limits of anisotropic growth on logarithmic time-scales
arxiv-2211-03676.creator: George Liddle, Amanda Turner
arxiv-2211-03676.description: Abstract We study the anisotropic version of the Hastings-Levitov model AHL ( ν ) (\nu) . Previous results have shown that on bounded time-scales the harmonic measure on the boundary of the cluster converges, in the small-particle limit, to the solution of a deterministic ordinary differential equation.

arxiv-2301-00990.title: The energy method for high-order invariants in shallow water wave equations
arxiv-2301-00990.creator: Qifeng Zhang, Tong Yan, Guang-hua Gao
arxiv-2301-00990.description: Abstract Third order dispersive evolution equations are widely adopted to model one-dimensional long waves and have extensive applications in fluid mechanics, plasma physics and nonlinear optics. Among them are the KdV equation, the Camassa–Holm equation and the Degasperis–Procesi equation. They share many common features such as complete integrability, Lax pairs and bi-Hamiltonian structure.

arxiv-2403-16127.title: WangchanLion and WangchanX MRC Eval
arxiv-2403-16127.creator: Wannaphong Phatthiyaphaibun, Surapon Nonesung, Patomporn Payoungkhamdee, Peerat Limkonchotiwat, Can Udomcharoenchaikit, Jitkapat Sawatphol, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Sarana Nutanong
arxiv-2403-16127.description: Abstract This technical report describes the development of WangchanLion, an instruction fine-tuned model focusing on Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) in the Thai language. Our model is based on SEA-LION and a collection of instruction following datasets. To promote open research and reproducibility, we publicly release all training data, code, and the final model weights under the Apache-2 license.

arxiv-2404-02882.title: Linear Attention Sequence Parallelism
arxiv-2404-02882.creator: Weigao Sun, Zhen Qin, Dong Li, Xuyang Shen, Yu Qiao, Yiran Zhong
arxiv-2404-02882.description: Abstract Sequence parallelism (SP) serves as a prevalent strategy to handle long sequences that exceed the memory limit of a single device. However, for linear sequence modeling methods like linear attention, existing SP approaches do not take advantage of their right-product-first feature, resulting in sub-optimal communication efficiency and usability.

arxiv-2404-06107.title: Exploring the Necessity of Visual Modality in Multimodal Machine Translation using Authentic Datasets
arxiv-2404-06107.description: Abstract Recent research in the field of multimodal machine translation (MMT) has indicated that the visual modality is either dispensable or offers only marginal advantages. However, most of these conclusions are drawn from the analysis of experimental results based on a limited set of bilingual sentence-image pairs, such as Multi30k.

arxiv-2408-05384.title: Nonlinear Propagation of Non-Gaussian Uncertainties
arxiv-2408-05384.creator: Giacomo Acciarini, Nicola Baresi, David Lloyd, Dario Izzo
arxiv-2408-05384.description: Abstract K eywords nonlinear uncertainty propagation \cdot non-Gaussian uncertainties \cdot moment generating functions \cdot MGF \cdot astrodynamics \cdot state transition tensors \cdot event transition tensors \cdot high-order variational equations \cdot differential algebra \cdot generalized dual numbers \cdot Fokker-Planck Equation 1 Introduction Uncertainty propagation plays a crucial role in various aspects of space trajectory design, including low-Earth orbit determination, satellite tracking,

arxiv-2510-03609.title: Learning Safety–Compatible Observers for Unknown Systems
arxiv-2510-03609.creator: Juho Bae, Daegyeong Roh, Han-Lim Choi
arxiv-2510-03609.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Juho Bae, Daegyeong Roh, Han-Lim Choi. This paper presents a data–driven approach for jointly learning a robust full–state observer and its robustness certificate for systems with unknown dynamics. Leveraging incremental input–to–state stability ( δ \delta ISS) notions, we jointly learn a δ \delta ISS Lyapunov function that serves as the robustness certificate and prove practical convergence of the estimation error under standard fidelity assumptions on the learned models.

arxiv-2510-08020.title: From Gas to Ice Giants: A Unified Mechanism for Equatorial Jets
arxiv-2510-08020.creator: Keren Duer-Milner, Nimrod Gavriel, Eli Galanti, Eli Tziperman, Yohai Kaspi
arxiv-2510-08020.description: Abstract The equatorial jets dominating the dynamics of the Jovian planets exhibit two distinct types of zonal flows: strongly eastward in the gas giants (superrotation) and strongly westward in the ice giants (subrotation). Existing theories propose different mechanisms for these patterns, but no single mechanism has successfully explained both.

arxiv-2511-09897.title: Theory and computation for structured variational inference
arxiv-2511-09897.description: Abstract Structured variational inference constitutes a core methodology in modern statistical applications. Unlike mean-field variational inference, the approximate posterior is assumed to have interdependent structure. We consider the natural setting of star-structured variational inference, where a root variable impacts all the other ones. We prove the first results for existence, uniqueness, and self-consistency of the variational approximation.

pmc-10651336.title: Hepatitis C Prevalence on the Rise but Screening at Safety Net Institutions Lagging behind
pmc-10651336.creator: Jarin Prasa, Syed S. Karim, Bobby Jacob, Paul Mustacchia
pmc-10651336.description: Introduction In the United States, the hepatitis C virus (HCV) is a leading contributor to liver-related illnesses and fatalities. Despite effective antiviral medications, acute infections have increased in recent years, likely due to IV drug use and the opioid epidemic. Previous guidelines recommended one-time screening for individuals born between 1945 and 1965.

pmc-11499674.title: Preliminary proteomic analysis of mouse lung tissue treated with cyclophosphamide and Venetin-1
pmc-11499674.creator: Paulina Czaplewska, Marc Müller, Natalia Musiał, Marcin Okrój, Anna Felberg-Miętka, Joanna Sadowska, Wioleta Dudzińska, Anna Lubkowska, Beata Tokarz-Deptuła, Marta Fiołka
pmc-11499674.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cyclophosphamide (CPAm) is a widely used chemotherapeutic agent that exhibits potent anti-cancer properties but is often associated with debilitating side effects. Despite its efficacy, the management of CPAm-induced toxicities remains a significant clinical challenge. There has been growing interest in exploring complementary and alternative therapies to mitigate these adverse effects in recent years, and this may be a chance for the earthworm-derived preparation, Venetin-1. Its rich composition of bioactive compounds has demonstrated promising pharmacological properties, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.

pmc-11633834.title: Integration of Multiple Climate Change Mitigation Actions and Health Co-Benefits: A Framework Using the Global Calculator
pmc-11633834.creator: Paolo Vineis, Lorenzo Mangone, Kristine Belesova, Cathryn Tonne, Rossella Alfano, Alexandre Strapasson, Christopher Millett, Neil Jennings, Jem Woods, Onesmus Mwabonje
pmc-11633834.description: Background:The Global Calculator is an open-source model of the world’s energy, land, and food systems. It is a pioneering online calculator to project the impact of interventions to mitigate climate change on global temperature. A few studies have been conducted to evaluate the health co-benefits of climate change mitigation, though they are still fragmentary.

pmc-12335209.title: Application of Self‐Expandable Metal Stent in Dogs and Cats for the Management of Extrahepatic Biliary Obstruction: 13 Cases (2021–2024)
pmc-12335209.creator: Suh Hyun Chai, Kyuseok Choi, Sungin Lee, Yongsun Kim
pmc-12335209.description: ObjectivesTo describe the clinical characteristics of 11 dogs and 2 cats with extrahepatic biliary obstruction (EHBO) who underwent self‐expandable metal stent (SEMS) placement. We also examined the indications for the procedure and evaluated its outcomes. Lastly, we identified risk factors associated with survival in these animals.

pmc-12466994.title: An Innovative Interactive Narrative Persona (INP) Approach for Virtual Reality-Based Dementia Tour Design (VDT) in Rehabilitation Contexts
pmc-12466994.creator: Yuk Ming Tang, Suet Yi Tse, Hoi Sze Chan, Ho Tung Yip, Hei Tung Cheung, Mohammed Woyeso Geda
pmc-12466994.description: The rising prevalence of dementia has raised significant public concern globally. However, the level of understanding and assistance concerning people with dementia remains limited. This study investigates the impact of virtual reality (VR) on enhancing public awareness and empathy toward dementia.

pmc-12606262.title: Energy-efficient strategies for maize-safflower cropping systems: comparative analysis of tillage and weed management practices
pmc-12606262.creator: Kasa Kiran Kumar Reddy, K P Vani, C Sudhakar, P Surendra Babu, S Triveni, Nallagatla Vinod Kumar, L Peace Raising
pmc-12606262.description: A two-year field experiment was conducted to evaluate tillage and weed management practices on productivity, profitability, and energetics in a maize–safflower cropping system under semi-arid tropical vertisols. Maize and safflower, being economically important crops with distinct cultivation requirements, require efficient tillage and weed management strategies for resource optimization and environmental sustainability.

pmc-13067466.title: Breakthroughs of bispecific antibodies therapy in multiple myeloma: latest updates from 2025 ASH
pmc-13067466.creator: Bihuan Zhao, Qiling Bu, Ai-Li Chen, Hong-Hu Zhu
pmc-13067466.description: Bispecific antibodies (BsAbs), which simultaneously target two antigens and redirect immune T cells toward tumor cells, have emerged as one of the most promising immunotherapeutic strategies for multiple myeloma (MM). Based on previously reported clinical data, several BsAbs have been approved for MM patients who relapsed in late-line treatment.

pmc-13089008.title: Effects of Vericiguat on the Mitochondrial Function and Clinical Outcomes in CRT Nonresponders Patients
pmc-13089008.creator: Celestino Sardu, Nunzia D’Onofrio, Carlo Fumagalli, Maria Luisa Balestrieri, Alessandro Landolfi, Carmine La Marca, Valerio Giordano, Isabella Donisi, Pietro Rambaldi, Gianluca Gatta, Salvatore Cappabianca, Ferdinando Carlo Sasso, Michelangela Barbieri, Giuseppe Paolisso, Raffaele Marfella
pmc-13089008.description: BackgroundCardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) failure leads to adverse remodeling and poor outcomes.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to evaluate vericiguat effects on outcomes, mitochondrial function, and inflammation/oxidative stress in CRT nonresponders at 1 year.MethodsIn this multicenter, observational prospective study, CRT nonresponders treated with vericiguat (n = 156) were compared with non-treated (n = 415).

pmc-13106428.title: Immunization with detoxified TNFα elicits neutralizing antibodies and ameliorates inflammatory shock and autoimmune arthritis in mice
pmc-13106428.creator: Wen-Ling Hsu, He Ren, Wei-Chiao Huang, Ramkumar T. Annamalai, Yumiao Zhang, Jonathan F. Lovell
pmc-13106428.description: IntroductionTumor necrosis factor-⍺ (TNF⍺) is central to the pathogenesis of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, and monoclonal antibody-based TNF⍺ inhibitors are amongst the most used biologics worldwide. As an alternative to exogenously administered antibodies, active immunization has been explored as a TNF⍺ neutralization strategy.MethodsWe generated a murine TNF⍺ (mTNF⍺) Y87S point mutant expressed in E.

pmc-13146002.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2301 PREHOSPITAL TIME INTERVALS IN STROKE PATIENTS ELIGIBLE FOR MECHANICAL THROMBECTOMY IN A RURAL TELEMEDICINE NETWORK
pmc-13146002.creator: Kathrin Hegenberg, Nikolai Hubert, Hanni Wiestler, Anastasios Mpotsaris, Gordian Hubert
pmc-13146002.description: Background and aimsEarly treatment is critical for favorable outcomes in acute ischaemic stroke, particularly in patients eligible for endovascular treatment (EVT). While in-hospital delays are well studied, the structure and relative contribution of specific pre-hospital pathways are less well characterized, particularly within telemedicine-supported stroke networks.

pmc-13172526.title: Response to Kawamoto et al
pmc-13172526.creator: Yoshikazu Johmura, Teh-Wei Wang, Makoto Nakanishi
pmc-13172526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Comment on “Reevaluating the Senolytic Activity of a GLS1 Inhibitor and an Anti-PD-1 Antibody: Toward Greater Reproducibility and Methodological Rigor” by Kawamoto et al. We have read the study reported by (Kawamoto et al, 2026) which intended to reproduce our previous findings on the senolytic activity of the GLS1 inhibitor BPTES (Johmura et al, 2021) and immune clearance of pre-accumulated senescent cells by anti-PD-1 treatment (Wang et al, 2022) in aged mice.

pmc-13286182.creator: Takuma Shimoyama, Yuya Kume, Mei Yamagata, Hideyuki Takahashi, Yoshihiro Nakata

pmc-13495658.title: Lung Cancer Screening Access and Cancer Stage at Diagnosis Among American Indian and White Patients
pmc-13495658.creator: Bradford E Jackson, Madison Uhrin, Stephanie B Wheeler, Christopher D Baggett, Lisa P Spees, Joel A Begay, Ronny A Bell, Marc A Emerson
pmc-13495658.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeGiven persistently low rates of lung cancer screening among eligible individuals, we examined racial and geographic differences in proximity to low‐dose computed tomography (LDCT) screening facilities among American Indians and Alaska Natives (AIAN) and White adults in North Carolina.MethodsWe used cancer registry data linked with health insurance claims (2016–2020) to examine a cohort of 18,154 AIAN and NHW lung cancer patients.

pmc-13538591.creator: Lin Zhang, Junming Xu, Weigang Wang, Rui Chang, Linghua Wang

pmc-13583841.title: Exploring long covid care pathways in the UK NHS: a qualitative study of healthcare professionals’ experiences
pmc-13583841.creator: Lanre Daodu, Yogini Raste, Judith E Allgrove, Francesca Arrigoni, Reem Kayyali
pmc-13583841.description: AbstractObjectivesTo explore the operational reality of the long covid care pathway from the perspective of National Health Service (NHS) professionals, addressing the gap between national guidelines and frontline implementation.DesignA qualitative study using single-timepoint, semi-structured interviews. Data were collected between July and October 2024. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis.

pmc-13616576.title: Early discontinuation of chemotherapy in older adults with early breast cancer: results from the prospective multicenter HOPE study
pmc-13616576.creator: Jingran Ji, Can-Lan Sun, William Dale, Harvey Jay Cohen, Heeyoung Kim, Vani Katheria, Nikita Baclig, Yuliya Zektser, Arman Niknafs, Samuel Margolis, Catherine Lee, Clarie Smith, Mina S Sedrak
pmc-13616576.description: Purpose:Older adults with early-stage breast cancer (EBC) receiving neo/adjuvant chemotherapy frequently discontinue treatment early. However, the incidence, risk factors, and survival implications of early discontinuation remain poorly understood.Methods:This is a post hoc analysis of 501 older adults (aged ≥65) with EBC treated with neo/adjuvant chemotherapy from the Hurria Older PatiEnts (HOPE) Study.
